From: Maya Patel <m.patel@ledgerlabs.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ alignment + evidence ask for Ledger Labs pilot

Hi Connor / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Ledger Labs is excited to move forward with a short pilot (private deployment) to validate latency and key management workflows. As part of our internal procurement and security review they asked for a filled CAIQ (CSA) sheet plus mapping to runtime evidence. To keep things scoped we need: 

- A completed CAIQ (prefilled answers) for our private deployment scope (data residency: US, dedicated nodes).
- For a subset of controls (identity, key management, tenancy/isolation, logging retention) we need proof artifacts (config snippets, sample logs, screenshots) we can include in our SIG/Procurement package.
- Confirmation on where KMS/HSM is used and whether customer-managed keys can be supported.

Timeline: they want the package by end of next week (Mar 30). Is that feasible? If helpful, we can restrict the initial submission to the 20 most relevant CAIQ questions and iterate.

Maya
Maya Patel
Security Program Lead, Ledger Labs
security@ledgerlabs.com

P.S. attaching the Ledger Labs CAIQ template they prefer as a reference (they often rename the columns).
[Attachment: ledgerlabs_caiq_template.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@ledgerlabs.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it.

High level plan: I can produce a scoped CAIQ answer set for the private deployment and include an evidence bundle focusing on the identity/KMS/telemetry controls you flagged. Kimberly will shepherd the control narratives and legal/attestation language. Proposed scope: pick the top 20 CAIQ items that matter for private deployments (I suggest starting with the CSA controls related to IAA, KEY, LOG, ISOL).

Attachments I will drop in the thread: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (prefill + control crosswalk). I will also include a sample runtime log extract and a short README that explains each artifact and the control it maps to.

Quick asks from your side:
- Can you confirm whether Ledger Labs needs customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) for the pilot, or if a Redwood-managed KMS with attestations is sufficient for initial review?
- Any redaction rules for logs (PII) so we can sanitize samples before sharing?

Tentative schedule:
- Today: initial CAIQ prefill (draft) and owner assignments.
- Wed (Mar 25): runtime log sample and key-management config snippet.
- Fri (Mar 27): final evidence bundle for internal review.
- Mon (Mar 30): handoff to Ledger Labs.

If the deadline is firm we can compress items; otherwise we can do an iterative submission.

Thanks — I'll start the prefill now and will upload the mapping sheet in a minute.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Looping Priyom here to own the runtime log extractions and the telemetry/retention examples. Priyom — please pull a 24-hour sampling window from our private cluster for the pilot tenant and redact any customer PII. Also include the agent config snippet that shows KV cache handling and batching attribution (maps to CSA: LOG-5 / INF-3).

Connor — I will write brief control narratives for the KMS/keys and tenant isolation controls and provide attestation language Kimberly Park, Director of Trust (example).

Maya — for the pilot, Redwood can support both Redwood-managed KMS and a limited BYOK workflow (customer keys in their HSM via a dedicated integration). For the first pass, would Redwood-managed attestations be acceptable? If not, we'll accelerate the BYOK playbook.

Owners & next steps:
- CAIQ prefill + mapping: Connor (owner)
- Runtime log sample + agent config: Priyom (owner)
- Control narratives + attestation wording: Kimberly (owner)
- Final packaging & DocuSign for an evidence NDA (if requested): Connor / Legal

I will block a 30-minute handoff tomorrow at 9am PT to review artifacts before we send to Ledger Labs.

KP
Kimberly Park
